note.summary: An EC2 instance (i-0c74a9d21e6b83f05) established contact with a command-and-control server over a 20-minute period, first querying a C&C-linked domain, then connecting to a C&C IP address, and finally exfiltrating data via DNS queries. The instance is actively compromised and under attacker control.
reasons: Three distinct findings over 20 minutes form a complete attack chain: DNS query to C&C domain, direct connection to C&C IP, and DNS-based data exfiltration.
Command-and-control activity indicates the attacker has established a callback channel and active control of the instance.
Data exfiltration finding shows the compromise has progressed beyond initial access to active data theft.
All three findings are high-severity (90/100) detections from GuardDuty's Backdoor and Trojan categories, indicating malware or persistent backdoor presence.
next_steps: Immediately isolate the instance from the network to prevent further C&C communication and data exfiltration.
Capture memory and disk forensics from the instance before termination to identify the malware, its persistence mechanisms, and what data was exfiltrated.
Review CloudTrail logs for the instance's launch, IAM role assignment, and any privilege escalation or lateral movement attempts.
Check for other instances in the account with similar network patterns or launched around the same time that may be part of the same compromise.
Identify and review what data the instance had access to and determine the scope of potential exfiltration.
